pure_dialect_vocal_tract_isolation_modul.core_law: Never mix Classical Arabic (Fusha) vowels, case endings, or prepositions with colloquial dialect, and never mix Iraqi and Bahrani dialect markers inside a single-dialect poem.

zero_word_initial_sukun_and_prosthetic_c.general_epenthetic_vowel_rule: Never place Sukun (ْ) on the first letter of any word. Repair plain initial consonant clusters with soft colloquial vowels.

mandatory_iraqi_prosthetic_clusters_modu.rule: Use prosthetic Kasra Alif ('إِ') + closed consonant Sukun on Iraqi labial/pharyngeal/velar/sibilant clusters to block Fusha damma/kasra injection ('ḥu-', 'bi-', ''u-') and enforce crisp palatal '/j/' constriction.

syncopated_iraqi_feminine_nouns.rule: Silence medial consonant before '-ya / -ḥa' to prevent Fusha 4-syllable expansion.

phonetic_colloquial_construct_state.rule: Write construct Taa Marbuta as phonetic 'تْ' without Fusha genitive kasra '-ti'.

diphthongs_and_boundary_sukun_locks.rule: Leave medial glide letters (ي, و) unmarked inside diphthongs to prevent abrupt Madd gating, and lock a single crisp Sukun (ْ) on closed word-final consonants before spaces or '..' to block cross-word slurring and Fusha case endings.

colloquial_particles_participles_and_hom.واو_العطف_الدارجة: وِعَرِّفْنِي / وِيْبَانْ / وِحُطْ / وِرَاوِينِي (Kasra liaison before consonants; 'وَ آنَه' before open Alif)
colloquial_particles_participles_and_hom.الموصولة_العراقية: إِلْ مِثِلْ زَينَبْ (Separated so model reads 'il-mithil', never 'al-mithil')
colloquial_particles_participles_and_hom.منع_لبس_الرسم: وَادِمْ (for 'وآدم' meaning people, preventing misreading as 'آدَم')

open_feminine_haa_without_sukun_rule.rule: Always write word-final feminine Haa/Taa Marbuta (ه) open WITHOUT Sukun so Lyria pronounces a soft colloquial /-a/ instead of an aspirated '-HHH'.

iraqi_interrogatives_and_gaf_normalizati.كَـ_orthographic: گ (إِشْگَدْ، گُوَّه، أَشْهَگْ، گِدَّامِي، فُوگِي، إِبْگَاعْ)

dialectal_and_prosodic_tanween_compiler_.colloquial_mid_line_tanween: Convert '-ٍ' to '-ِنْ' and vocalize imperfect verb prefix with Kasra (عينٍ تسيل -> عَينِنْ تِسِيلْ، جرحٍ چبير -> جَرْحِنْ چِبِيرْ، عذراً -> عِذْرَنْ).
dialectal_and_prosodic_tanween_compiler_.fusha_mid_line_and_pause_tanween: Convert mid-line Tanween phonetically (أماناً يا -> أَمَانَنْ يَا، مستمسكاً بيدي -> مُسْتَمْسِكَنْ بِيَدِي); convert pause '-اً' to '-َا' (ظَامِئَا) and drop '-ٌ/-ٍ' to Sukun (ْ).
dialectal_and_prosodic_tanween_compiler_.pre_pause_sukun_placement: Place end-of-hemistich Sukun (ْ) on closed final consonants BEFORE '..', never on open feminine Haa ('ـه') and never after '..'.
